newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FIJI RUGBY UNION PLAYERS ACQUITTED ON ASSAULT CHARGES.
newsitem.headline: FIJI RUGBY UNION PLAYERS ACQUITTED ON ASSAULT CHARGES.

text.p: Three members of a Fijian rugby team charged with indecently assaulting three women in Hong Kong were acquitted on Thursday, government radio said.

Magistrate Amanda Woodcock said she believed the women were indecently assaulted, but she was not satisfied that the case against Save Lutumailagi, Meli Nakauta and Manoa Kasamaivomo had been proven beyond reasonable doubt, the radio said.
The players, who denied the charges, were members of a Fijian team that finished as runners up in a rugby 10-a-side competition in the British colony last week.
